basic_info.description:
This spacious and contemporary one bedroom and one bathroom residence is located in a full service elevator building in coveted Russian Hill. This fabulous condominium features an open floor plan, modern kitchen, built in entertainment center, and a beautiful window seat which fills the living room with light from sunny south exposure. This unit also features in unit laundry, one car parking, additional storage, and a common garden and roof deck with views of the Bay and the Golden Gate Bridge. 
Right in the heart of Russian Hill, this residence is less than one block away from spectacular restaurants, bars, and shopping.
